title: Unfamiliar supported authoring

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.

allowedWork: Exact approved 20 slices; trial sources, evidence, scoped tests and evidenced packet corrections. One fresh-context local author agent, no inherited history, no model override or subdelegation. Standing measured budget repairs within scope.
disallowedWork: No production schema, semantic engine, renderer, layout, clock, motif, external API, new math family, merge, deployment or automatic successor. Do not hide failed cases or specialist intervention.
goal: Measure five unfamiliar repeated-group authoring variants through existing canonical integration, with honest failures and zero engine edits.
commitCadence: One scoped commit per verified slice including closed receipt and evidence.
stopConditions: Human review at s17 before promotion; preserve canonical exemplars, three stops and shared revision. Source-only review refinements are allowed; changed motion or layout is outside scope.

Stop for missing authority, unsafe action, user pause, unrecoverable evidence loss or blocked remaining independent work. Local case failures are observations; record them and continue unaffected work. Finish at s20.
